scope: Complete tracked repository path/object manifest, excluding this catalogue itself. Per-theorem provenance covers only explicitly recorded declarations; no corpus-wide theorem, publication, or verification coverage is implied.
organization: The adaptation source view mirrors actual GRWTSK paths. Isolated dependency environments are subordinate build support. Source editions and publications remain many-to-many references.
snapshot_semantics: Path/object manifest of the staged publication tree, excluding this catalogue to avoid a self-hash cycle. base_revision identifies the parent history inspected before this reorganization; it is not asserted to be the revision of moved files. Immutable per-theorem source URLs retain their original revisions.
reference_semantics: References and publication citations are many-to-many source observations. Shared references do not establish theorem identity, equivalence, independence, priority, or mathematical acceptance. Per-theorem provenance records retain the detailed evidence scope.
declaration_identity_scope: Declaration spelling is transcribed from the existing provenance record; no Lean elaboration or namespace verification is asserted.
